detail: Full summary: Dashboard API ships full datasets with no pagination/filtering/aggregation: /api/blackboard, /api/decisions, /api/graph in src/dashboard/api-routes.ts return everything; frontend polls and refetches the entire active-tab dataset every tick (app.js refreshData).
